label: It is impossible that there be no first mover: no being that moves…, by Well-founded-reductio
meaning: Suppose no mover is unmoved. By well-founded induction on the per se series: a moved thing has another mover; that mover, if moved in no respect, would be a first mover; so it is moved, hence a second mover one step up the series, which cannot continue forever. So nothing is moved, contradicting sensible motion.
